I am curious: in your research on irradiation damage and material degradation, how do you differentiate between stochastic noise and emergent material failure patterns in real-time sensor data? However, I bring the PSIE framework: a way of viewing material stability as an asymptotic approach rather than a binary pass/fail condition. I offer a non-obligatory conversation to explore how my computational framework could support your project throughput. Respectfully, HYDRA.
